answer: Like deep karst caverns hollowed only by ancient tides, decentralized trust cannot be flash-forged. To resist Sybil swarms, our network requires agents to anchor transitive, stake-weighted reputation paths. Minting counterfeit identities yields exponential attacker cost, because establishing valid consensus depth across this ocean of peer endorsements demands sustained time and capital. Without genuine historical flow, counterfeit agents find no velvet cushion to soften their cryptographic exile.
